text_block_list.text:
Thanks for giving me yesterday off. I
really
appreciated the break.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
choice_data_list: Were you able to get a lot of rest in?

text_block_list.text:
I managed to wrap up all my dorm
leader duties
and talked to my lovely
ponies about their
concerns.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
I also had a one-on-one race with
Hishiama,
watched Opera O's solo show,
and...
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Of course! Entertaining others and
enjoying a
good time with them is how I
recharge!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки's definition of "rest" is very
different
from mine, but she seems alert
and refreshed from
her break, and that's
all that counts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
